newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon gets $129 mln contract for refinery.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon gets $129 mln contract for refinery.

text.p: Raytheon Co said its Raytheon Engineers & Constructors has received a $129 million turnkey contract from Slovnaft a.s to add a fluid catalytic cracker complex to Slovnaft's refinery in Bratislava, Slovakia.
Raytheon said it will provide detailed engineering, procurement, construction, and start-up services for the project, which will increase the high-grade gasoline production of the refinery.
Work will begin immediately and is scheduled to be completed by the end of 1998, the company said.
Slovnaft a.s., Slovakia's sole oil refiner and petrochemical company, is 25 percent state owned and 75 percent privatized.
